testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a solid face while command key tips are visible ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with its asymmetric solid visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is selected ✔ When the user presses Alt and then the 3D Model tab key tip ✔ Then command-level ribbon key tips are visible ✔ When the user clicks a visible solid face ✔ Then the ribbon key tips disappear ✔ And the clicked face is selected ✔ And a contextual mini toolbar appears beside the selected face ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the face selection and contextual mini toolbar clear
